verses.text: [A Psalm] of David. A Maskil. How blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered!
verses.textZh: （大衛的訓誨詩。）得赦免其過、遮蓋其罪的，這人是有福的！

verses.text: How blessed is the man to whom the LORD does not impute iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no deceit!
verses.textZh: 凡心裡沒有詭詐、耶和華不算為有罪的，這人是有福的！

verses.text: When I kept silent [about my sin], my body wasted away Through my groaning all day long.
verses.textZh: 我閉口不認罪的時候，因終日唉哼而骨頭枯乾。

verses.text: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; My vitality was drained away [as] with the fever heat of summer. Selah.
verses.textZh: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重；我的精液耗盡，如同夏天的乾旱。（細拉）

verses.text: I acknowledged my sin to You, And my iniquity I did not hide; I said, 'I will confess my transgressions to the LORD'; And You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah.
verses.textZh: 我向你陳明我的罪，不隱瞞我的惡。我說：我要向耶和華承認我的過犯，你就赦免我的罪惡。（細拉）

verses.text: Therefore, let everyone who is godly pray to You in a time when You may be found; Surely in a flood of great waters they will not reach him.
verses.textZh: 為此，凡虔誠人都當趁你可尋找的時候禱告你；大水泛溢的時候，必不能到他那裡。

verses.text: You are my hiding place; You preserve me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.textZh: 你是我藏身之處；你必保佑我脫離苦難，以得救的樂歌四面環繞我。（細拉）

verses.text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you should go; I will counsel you with My eye upon you.
verses.textZh: 我要教導你，指示你當行的路；我要定睛在你身上勸戒你。

verses.text: Do not be as the horse or as the mule which have no understanding, Whose trappings include bit and bridle to hold them in check, [Otherwise] they will not come near to you.
verses.textZh: 你不可像那無知的騾馬，必用嚼環轡頭勒住他；不然，就不能馴服。

verses.text: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, But he who trusts in the LORD, lovingkindness shall surround him.
verses.textZh: 惡人必多受苦楚；惟獨倚靠耶和華的必有慈愛四面環繞他。

verses.text: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, you righteous ones; And shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart.
verses.textZh: 你們義人應當靠耶和華歡喜快樂；你們心裡正直的人都當歡呼。
